# Binary.ViewFunction

```m
Binary.ViewFunction(function as function) as function
```

Creates a function that can be intercepted by a handler defined on a view (via Binary.View).

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/binary-viewfunction)
